Read, filter, rename and translate the patient table

Source: R/metadata.R
load_patient_table.Rd

Detects the delimiter and the encoding (German exports are often latin1), trims whitespace, tolerates umlaut spelling variants, converts decimal commas, and PASSES THROUGH any value not in the dictionary while reporting it – silently mangling an unmapped clinical value would be worse than leaving it in German for the user to map.

Usage

load_patient_table(
  path,
  column_map = default_column_map(),
  value_map = default_value_map(),
  reference_date = Sys.Date()
)

Arguments

path

File path.

column_map

The column map. Default default_column_map().

value_map

The value map. Default default_value_map().

reference_date

The reference date. Default Sys.Date().
